notablePrerequisites:
"Vampire" chosen with Conspiracy.
NOTE: There is a small chance of failure if you have an odd number of cards in library at any point during this combo.
description:
Activate Anje Falkenrath by tapping it and discarding Necroplasm.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
 Resolve Anje Falkenrath's ability, choosing to mill two cards and return Necroplasm from your graveyard to your hand instead of drawing.
Repeat until you mill Kozilek.
Kozilek triggers, shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Repeat.
